about.heading: Building A Disciplined BGMI Community In India
paragraphs: NexusX Esports India is an independent competitive gaming community focused on Battlegrounds Mobile India (BGMI) tournaments across Solo and Squad formats.
Our goal is to provide players and rising teams with clear tournament schedules, transparent registration workflows, and straightforward rules so competitors can focus on gameplay.

pillars.title: Gaming Community
pillars.description: A shared space for BGMI players, IGLs, and mobile squads across India to connect and compete.

pillars.title: Competitive Integrity
pillars.description: Clear eligibility checks, honest result publishing, and consistent enforcement of published tournament rules.

pillars.title: Accessible Participation
pillars.description: Simple registration through official Google Forms and timely match announcements via community channels.

about.vision: To grow a reliable, transparent grassroots esports ecosystem where emerging Indian BGMI players can showcase skill and team coordination.

termsSections.title: 1. Registration Eligibility
termsSections.content: Participants must satisfy the minimum account, region, and device requirements listed on the specific tournament page and submit accurate information through the official Google Form before the registration deadline.

termsSections.title: 2. Tournament Participation & Reporting
termsSections.content: Registered players and squad captains must adhere to the published reporting time and match start time (IST). Late check-ins may forfeit lobby slots at organizer discretion.

termsSections.title: 3. Fair Play, Cheating & Teaming Restrictions
termsSections.content: Cheating, modified game clients, third-party scripts, stream sniping, bug exploitation, and teaming with rival players or squads are strictly prohibited.

termsSections.title: 4. Emulator & Device Restrictions
termsSections.content: Each tournament page specifies eligible devices. Unless explicitly stated otherwise for a special event, unauthorized emulators or restricted hardware peripherals are not permitted.

termsSections.title: 5. Match Reporting & Result Verification
termsSections.content: Players or captains may be asked to submit post-match scoreboards or screen recordings for verification prior to final standings approval.

termsSections.title: 6. Prize Distribution
termsSections.content: Where prizes are configured for an event, payouts are issued only after final result verification and confirmation of valid recipient details.

termsSections.title: 7. Disqualification & Organizer Decisions
termsSections.content: Violation of tournament rules or unsportsmanlike conduct may result in disqualification. NexusX Esports India reserves the right to amend rules for operational clarity; decisions made by tournament administration are final.
